scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const paths=['.next'];for(const p of paths){if(fs.existsSync(p)){fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}}for(const name of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(name.startsWith('.next_stale_')){fs.rmSync(name,{recursive:true,force:true});}}"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run clean && npm run dev
scripts.test:prepare: rm -f prisma/test.db prisma/test.db-journal && DATABASE_URL="file:./test.db" npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test:e2e: echo "E2E tests are not configured yet"
